**Download:** `GamePresetPeek-{version}-setup.exe` to install it, or `GamePresetPeek-{version}-portable.zip` for a portable copy that keeps its settings, log and cache in its own folder. Runs on 64-bit Windows 10 and 11.

The program is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn about it: click **More info → Run anyway**.
